scenes.title: Sela Thorn at pier four
scenes.summary: The party meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader mending a net, who agrees to row them for two silver but never at night. She says Saltmere Mine flooded forty years ago the night the bell first rang, with warm water, and offers a ride at first light tomorrow.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The warm, candle-wax-smelling tunnel floods thirty paces in, with hymn-book pages floating on the water. Teo finds a page with the pencilled margin note "M. Brand" and recognizes his sister Mira's handwriting; Dana guesses Maren the harbor-master is in the cult; Oren takes 2 damage from bad air (down to 11).

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins, Gullwick bay
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother, who pulls children down by the ankles, and leave. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under the water, the humming is much louder, and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor; the GM notes the choir clock is at three of six. The party flees.

scenes.title: Plan for the dive at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull, tavern by the docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light tomorrow and dive to the chapel at low tide; Dana will buy rope and a second lantern. Innkeeper Bram feeds them, says he has known Maren for thirty years and that she lost a brother to the bay. Long rest, back to full.
